findings.evidence: At lines 122–127 (and analogously 344–349 and 566–571), the `/-- … root lattice is nondegenerate. -/` comment immediately precedes the private determinant theorem, while the instance follows after that theorem’s proof.
findings.fix: Give each determinant helper an accurate ordinary comment or docstring, and add the nondegeneracy description directly above each exported `instIsNondegenerateTypeE…RootLattice` instance.
findings.issue: The E₆, E₇, and E₈ nondegeneracy docstrings attach to `det_cartanMatrixE₆_ne_zero`, `det_cartanMatrixE₇_ne_zero`, and `det_cartanMatrixE₈_ne_zero`, whose statements only assert nonzero determinants; the exported instances at lines 127, 349, and 571 consequently have no docstrings.

summary: The nondegeneracy instances are undocumented because their apparent docstrings attach to private determinant lemmas and overstate those lemmas.
